class.name: ResonanceListener
class.brief_description: Native audio listener node for Nexus Resonance.
class.description: Reports listener position and orientation to [ResonanceServer] each frame from this node's global transform (forward = -Z, up = Y). Attach as a child of a [Camera3D] so the listener follows the camera. Only the listener under the active viewport camera drives the server; other listeners stay inactive so they do not overwrite the active pose. When no ResonanceListener is in the scene, [ResonanceRuntime] falls back to the active camera transform. Draws reflection debug rays from this node's origin when [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.realtime_rays] is greater than 0 on [member ResonanceRuntime.runtime] and the player overlay is active on [ResonanceRuntime] ([member ResonanceRuntime.enable_debug] plus the overlay toggle key). On Windows, pathing is protected by an SEH safety net when the listener moves through solid geometry; you do not need to disable [member listener_valid] for those cases.

members.member: When true, the server runs path validation for pathing. When false, pathing is skipped entirely (saves CPU). Set to false when you explicitly want to disable pathing, such as a debug camera inside geometry.
